entities.summary: Carmen Pimentel is a Peruvian former volleyball player who competed in the 1980 Summer Olympics in Moscow and the 1984 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles. She was a member of the Peruvian team that won the silver medal at the 1982 FIVB World Championship in Peru. She was a setter.
